phrases.text: Okay so the question is should our school ban phones during the whole school day
I think yes because people are on their phones in class and they don't pay attention to the lesson.
But what about emergencies like if your parents need to reach you
That's true but the office has a phone so parents can call the office.
How do you know the office would actually get the message to you in time?
I guess I don't know for sure.
Yeah.
For example last year when the fire alarm went off nobody could find their parents and the office line was busy the whole time
Building on what Priya said, maybe the rule could be phones stay in lockers unless there's an emergency.
But then who decides what counts as an emergency
Is that allowed?
What do you think Sam?
I think phones are distracting so maybe lockers is fine.
I agree with Sam because the research says students do better on tests when phones are out of the room, like twenty percent of kids said they get distracted by phones
Which research though? Where did you read that?
It was in the article we read in class, the one from the news.
So it seems like most of us think the phones should be in lockers but with an emergency plan.
Okay can we talk about homework now? Should teachers give homework on weekends?
No.
I don't think weekend homework helps because kids need rest and time with family
What if the homework is just reading though would that still be bad
Reading is different, I see your point, but it still depends on how much reading there is.
My cousin's school has no weekend homework and their grades went up so homework might not even matter that much
Why do you think their grades went up? Maybe it was something else, like better teachers.
That's a good point, maybe it was the teachers, I'm not sure.
Do we have homework this weekend?
Ha, yes we do, for math.
If kids are more rested then they might actually learn more during the week, so less weekend homework could help grades.
I disagree with Maya, some kids need practice or they forget everything by Monday
Are you assuming everyone has time to practice at home? Some kids have jobs or take care of siblings on weekends.
Okay that's fair, not everyone has the same weekend.
I like weekends.
